create_epsilon_greedy_distribution: create an EpsilonGreedy distribution from unnormalized preferences and an epsilon mixing parameter
sample_epsilon_greedy_actions: sample actions from an EpsilonGreedy distribution that mixes greedy and uniform choices
compute_argmax_with_tie_breaking: compute greedy action probabilities with random tie-breaking across equal-preference actions
mix_probs_with_uniform: mix a categorical probability distribution with a uniform distribution using an epsilon weight
index_epsilon_greedy_batch: index into a batched EpsilonGreedy distribution to extract a subset of preferences
